d: Snoonu is seeking a highly driven and analytical Category Manager to lead our Home and Pet products. This role is critical in shaping our assortment, improving profitability, and enhancing the customer experience across our dark store network. As a Category Manager, you will take full ownership of the performance, availability, and commercial success of your category, working closely with cross-functional teams including Supply Chain, Operations, and Marketing to ensure the right products are available at the right time and price
q: Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Economics, Engineering, or a related field.
3–5 years of experience in Category Management, Retail, FMCG, or E-commerce.
Strong understanding of the category and customer purchase behavior is preferred.
Experience analyzing commercial performance using Excel and BI tools.
Knowledge of merchandising, promotions, assortment planning, and supplier management.
Strong organizational and project management skills.
Customer-first mindset with strong commercial awareness.
Excellent relationship-building and stakeholder management skills.
Analytical and detail-oriented with strong problem-solving abilities.
Proactive, adaptable, and able to thrive in a fast-paced environment.
Effective communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.
